summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx combined with olaparib as maintenance therapy for platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian, peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer. Mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx is given by IV infusion on Day 1 of every 3-week cycle at 5 mg/kg, and olaparib is taken by mouth at 300 mg twice daily; treatment continues until progression, unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal of consent, or death. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa mirvetuximab soravtansina-gynx combinado con olaparib como terapia de mantenimiento para cáncer de ovario, peritoneal o de trompas de Falopio recurrente y sensible al platino. El mirvetuximab se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 3 semanas, a 5 mg/kg, y el olaparib se toma por vía oral a 300 mg dos veces al día; el tratamiento continúa hasta progresión, toxicidad inaceptable, retiro del consentimiento o muerte. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Women aged 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
High-grade serous or endometrioid ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer.
Platinum-sensitive disease, with progression more than 6 months after the last prior platinum dose.
Complete or partial response, or stable disease, after the last line of platinum therapy.
Archival tissue confirming folate receptor alpha (FRα) high or medium expression.
not_for: Clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatous, borderline, germ cell, or sex-cord stromal ovarian tumors.
Progression through the most recent chemotherapy regimen (stable disease is allowed).
Prior treatment with mirvetuximab or other FRα-targeting agents.
Untreated or symptomatic brain or central nervous system metastases.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those unwilling to use highly effective contraception.
